| 1 | Who this applies to; LF25 | An ordinary Spanish resident whose habitual residence falls in Navarra uses Navarra IRPF. A resident whose habitual residence falls in Bizkaia, Álava or Gipuzkoa uses that historical territory's IRPF. These are separate complete income-tax systems, not an additional autonomous-community percentage on top of the State scale. Apply the residence tests in order: greatest number of days during the tax period, counting temporary absences and the rebuttable habitual-home presumption; then principal centre of interests using the statutory income exclusions; then last declared IRPF residence. A Spanish resident spending no more than 183 days in Spain uses the principal economic-interest test. Keep the spouse/minor-child residence presumption and artificial residence-change rules in the applicable agreement. Mixed-territory joint returns follow the member with the largest taxable base calculated under that member's applicable law. Sources: Basque Economic Agreement arts 6 and 43 [Basque Economic Agreement, current consolidated law](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2002-9969); Navarra Economic Agreement arts 8–9 [Navarra Economic Agreement, current consolidated law](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1990-31117). | Basque Economic Agreement article 43 | https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2002-9969#a43 | Primera. Cuando permanezcan en dicho territorio un mayor número de días del período impositivo, en el Impuesto sobre la Renta de las Personas Físicas; del año inmediato anterior, contado de fecha a fecha, que finalice el día anterior al de devengo, en el Impuesto sobre Sucesiones y Donaciones, en el Impuesto sobre Transmisiones Patrimoniales y Actos Jurídicos Documentados, y en el Impuesto Especial sobre Determinados Medios de Transporte. | 2026-10-28 | rule |

Cuando tengan en éste su principal centro de intereses, considerándose como tal el territorio donde obtengan la mayor parte de la base imponible del Impuesto sobre la Renta de las Personas Físicas excluyéndose, a estos efectos, las rentas y ganancias patrimoniales derivadas del capital mobiliario, así como las bases imputadas en el régimen de transparencia fiscal excepto el profesional. | 2026-10-28 | rule |

Las personas físicas residentes en territorio español, que no permanezcan en dicho territorio más de ciento ochenta y tres días durante el año natural, se considerarán residentes en el territorio del País Vasco, cuando en el mismo radique el núcleo principal o la base de sus actividades empresariales o profesionales o de sus intereses económicos. | 2026-10-28 | rule |

These are separate complete income-tax systems, not an additional autonomous-community percentage on top of the State scale. A Spanish resident spending no more than 183 days in Spain uses the principal economic-interest test. Sources: Basque Economic Agreement arts 6 and 43 [Basque Economic Agreement, current consolidated law](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2002-9969); Navarra Economic Agreement arts 8–9 [Navarra Economic Agreement, current consolidated law](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1990-31117). | Basque Economic Agreement article 6 | https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2002-9969#a6 | Dos. Cuando los contribuyentes integrados en una unidad familiar tuvieran su residencia habitual en territorios distintos y optasen por la tributación conjunta, se entenderá competente la Administración del territorio donde tenga su residencia habitual el miembro de dicha unidad con mayor base liquidable, calculada conforme a su respectiva normativa. | 2026-10-28 | rule |
| 6 | Who this applies to; LF27 | Payroll withholding jurisdiction is a separate decision from the employee's final annual IRPF residence. The Basque art 7 employment-service/assigned-work-centre rules expressly cover mixed working locations, telework, overseas work and ships; public pensions use the recipient's habitual residence; directors use the paying entity's fiscal domicile and the prescribed mixed-corporate allocation. Apply the public-State-employer exception rather than moving all State payroll to a province. Navarra arts 10–16 contain its separate withholding points of connection. A resident's final return credits the properly attributable withholding even where a different administration collected it. [Basque Economic Agreement, current consolidated law](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2002-9969)[Navarra Economic Agreement, current consolidated law](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1990-31117) | Basque Economic Agreement article 7 | https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2002-9969#a7 | Asimismo en el caso de teletrabajo y en los supuestos en que los trabajos o servicios se presten en el extranjero, o en buques, embarcaciones, artefactos navales o plataformas fijas en el mar se entenderán prestados en el centro de trabajo al que esté adscrita la persona trabajadora. | 2026-10-28 | rule |

| 23 | The base / Foreign-assignment employment: local exemptions; LF48 | Select the competent territory before testing this ordinary resident-employee method. All four require actual foreign work for a non-Spanish-resident enterprise/entity or an overseas permanent establishment, and the comparable-income-tax/non-tax-haven condition in the **own** local law. A treaty with Spain containing an information-exchange clause satisfies the stated comparable-tax limb; without one, prove the analogous tax and the applicable local jurisdiction classification for that tax period. A foreign payer or work done from Spain does not by itself qualify. For linked recipients, the own local corporate rule must establish an intragroup service producing or capable of producing an advantage or utility for the recipient: Basque corporate art44.1, Navarra LF26/2016 art33, as incorporated by the local exemption/regulation and explained in the own manuals. Retain actual contracts, assignment calendar, foreign-beneficiary project/service evidence, remuneration and tax certificates. Do not transplant State7(p)'s administrative denominator correction to a local rule without its own source bridge. | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 9 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a9 | 17. | 30 | The base / Foreign-assignment employment: local exemptions; LF57 | **Ordinary full-year worksheet.** For a single employment relationship lasting all2026, segregate specific eligible foreign-service pay `S` from nonspecific salary `N`. With `D` evidenced qualifying foreign-assignment days and365 calendar days, calculate `eligible_foreign_pay = S + N ×D/365`; exempt the lesser of that amount and the territory's annual cap in the table. Specific pay is not prorated again. Subtract only that exemption from otherwise taxable gross salary, then apply the selected territory's employee expense/bonus rules; this is not a deduction of60,100/60,000 from every salary. The annual cap is one per taxpayer/year, not per trip or country. The own B/A/G regulations each expressly use total days of the year; the current own Navarra regulation permits the shorter accrual duration. A fully evidenced45-day assignment,36,500 nonspecific salary and2,000 specific pay gives6,500 exempt in each of the four systems and32,000 residual gross before local expenses. With80,000 wholly eligible foreign salary and no separate exempt reimbursement, B/A/G exemption is60,100 and residual19,900; Navarra exemption is60,000 and residual20,000. [B DF47/2014](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241); [A DF40/2014](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice-reglamento_irpf_cas-2-pdf); [G DF33/2014](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0755457E7/DF%2033-2014%20(2026-2).pdf/7e4c25eb-a139-fa5f-d310-deaa4c4bcffd); [N DF174/1999](https://www.navarra.es/es/web/normativa-hacienda/-/reglamento-del-impuesto-sobre-la-renta-de-las-personas-f%C3%ADsicas-df-174/1999-de-24-de-mayo-?print=true). | B DF47/2014 article 11 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241#a11 | Para el cálculo del importe de los rendimientos devengados cada día por los trabajos realizados en el extranjero, al margen de las retribuciones específicas correspondientes a los citados trabajos, se aplicará un criterio de reparto proporcional teniendo en cuenta el número total de días del año. | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

The own B/A/G regulations each expressly use total days of the year; the current own Navarra regulation permits the shorter accrual duration. A fully evidenced45-day assignment,36,500 nonspecific salary and2,000 specific pay gives6,500 exempt in each of the four systems and32,000 residual gross before local expenses. With80,000 wholly eligible foreign salary and no separate exempt reimbursement, B/A/G exemption is60,100 and residual19,900; Navarra exemption is60,000 and residual20,000. If the independently computed local taxable-income ceiling is4,975, Álava credit is1,990 whereas Bizkaia's published full-foreign-tax limb gives `min(8,000,4,975)=4,975`. These declared-input controls isolate the actual administrative difference; they do not establish the expense/base ceiling or entitlement for a different source pattern. The Álava instruction is explicitly2024, read with currentart92; no2026 campaign instruction is implied. Gipuzkoa91/Navarra67 require the actual relevant foreign tax and taxable-income ceiling; own implementation for allocating a single foreign-tax amount across exempt and nonexempt wages remains an ordinary question where decisive, and neither the Bizkaia full-tax instruction nor Álava's proportional instruction is automatically theirs. | 78 | The base / Employment income and sole-trader income; LF84 | Ordinary sole traders calculate actual business income less deductible business costs using the territorial corporate-tax rules and the modifications in IRPF arts 25–27. Include gains and losses on business assets in the business result, with the art 75.3 general-rate adjustment if the general average tax rate exceeds the applicable general corporate rate. Under each territory's art 25.1, ordinary simplified direct assessment requires aggregate turnover for all the taxpayer's activities not exceeding 600,000 in the preceding year and the express election required by the regulation. For a start year use that year's turnover, annualised if the activity ran for less than a full year. Confirm the election before using art 28; this is not an automatic choice between the normal and simplified computations. The named sector exceptions have their own rules. [Bizkaia NF13/2013](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068) [Álava NF33/2013](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf) [Gipuzkoa NF3/2014](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc) art.25.1. Art 28 excludes depreciation, impairment and the specified vehicle/lease expenses from the initial actual-expense computation; the prescribed allowance replaces them. These percentages are not the common-territory 5% expense allowance: | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 25 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a25 | b) Simplificada. Esta modalidad se aplicará para determinadas actividades económicas cuyo volumen de operaciones, para el conjunto de actividades desarrolladas por el contribuyente, no supere 600.000 euros en el año inmediato anterior. | 2026-10-28 | rule |

| 109 | The base / Employment income and sole-trader income; LF94 | Under each territory's art 25.5, a qualifying newly started activity reduces its positive net result by 10% for a man or 15% for a woman, after any applicable art 25.4 integration. Apply this in the first positive tax period and the following tax period, provided the first positive period falls within the first five tax periods after starting. A previously carried-on activity, directly or indirectly, is not new; the same IAE tariff group establishes the same activity. The reduction fails for a period in which more than 50% of the new activity's income comes from a person or entity that paid the taxpayer employment income in the year before the activity started. [Bizkaia NF13/2013](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068) [Álava NF33/2013](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf) [Gipuzkoa NF3/2014](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc) art.25.5. A qualifying positive50,000 result becomes45,000 at10% or42,500 at15%; the preceding eligibility conditions must be established first. | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 25 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a25 | 5. Las personas contribuyentes que inicien el ejercicio de una actividad económica podrán reducir en un 10 por 100 el rendimiento neto positivo de la misma y en un 15 por 100 si son mujeres, una vez aplicado, en su caso, lo dispuesto en el apartado anterior, en el primer periodo impositivo en el que este sea positivo y en el periodo impositivo siguiente, siempre que el primer periodo impositivo en que se obtenga dicho rendimiento neto positivo tenga lugar en los cinco primeros periodos impositivos desde el inicio de su actividad. A estos efectos no se entenderá que se inicia el ejercicio de una actividad económica, cuando la misma se haya desarrollado con anterioridad directa o indirectamente por la persona contribuyente. No resultará de aplicación esta reducción en el periodo impositivo en el que más del 50 por 100 de los ingresos derivados de la actividad económica iniciada procedan de una persona o entidad de la que la persona contribuyente hubiera obtenido rendimientos de trabajo en el año anterior a la fecha de inicio de la actividad. | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

| 115 | The base / General and savings baskets, reductions and pensions; LF98 | Under arts 62–66 classify employment, ordinary business income and other general income separately from savings income. | 187 | The base / Ordinary home and small-disposal gain exemptions; LF128 | Habitual-home status is an evidence condition, not the address label on the sale deed. The ordinary Basque definition requires at least **three years' continuous residence** and effective permanent occupation within **twelve months** of acquisition/completion, subject to the stated necessary-move, death and employment-housing exceptions. For the age/dependency and reinvestment exemptions, a home qualifying at disposal or on any day within the previous **two years** remains within the specific former-home rule. B67.4 and G64.4 also preserve status after a required move to specified relatives' homes or residential care because of dependency/serious illness, provided there is no different use of the old home; do not insert that additional text into A61.4. B/A/G have their own annex/single-registered-property and family-main-home conditions. [B regulation67](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241), [A regulation61](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice-reglamento_irpf_cas-2-pdf), [G regulation64](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0755457E7/DF%2033-2014%20(2026-2).pdf/7e4c25eb-a139-fa5f-d310-deaa4c4bcffd). Navarra's own regulation40.1/6 supplies its three-year, twelve-month and previous-two-year conditions and necessary-move exceptions; its reinvestment definition includes a simultaneously acquired storage room and at most two garages, rather than the Basque single-registered-property test. | 203 | The base / Replacement-home reinvestment method; LF134 | Use **B/A/G law49 with B regulation49, A46 or G45**, or **Navarra law45.1 with regulation40**. Establish both homes' local habitual-home conditions and qualifying acquisition/rehabilitation evidence. Álava and Gipuzkoa law49 expressly require full ownership of both homes, allowing shared full ownership with other co-owners; bare ownership/usufruct alone does not satisfy that sentence. B/A law49.3 separately admits the specified former family home left under a judicial separation/partnership-dissolution decision, subject to continuing habitual-home status for the former spouse/partner and, in B, the applicable descendants. Obtain that judicial/residence evidence before using the exception. For an ordinary positive-gain case, let `G` be the properly measured gain, `P` the tax transfer value and `L` outstanding principal of the loan used to acquire the sold home. The reinvestment target is `T = P − L`, **not the gain and not the original mortgage amount**. Let `R` be the eligible timely amount reinvested. If `R ≥ T`, the gain is fully exempt; if `0 ≤ R < T`, `exempt_gain = G × R / T` and `taxable_gain = G − exempt_gain`. These formulas assume a positive target and gain; a zero/negative-target case needs its own actual transaction treatment rather than division by zero. A sale with P300,000, outstanding acquisition principal100,000, gain100,000 and eligible reinvestment150,000 gives target200,000 and exempt gain75,000, leaving25,000 taxable. Dividing by gross300,000 would incorrectly leave50,000 taxable. [B law49](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068), [A law49](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf), [G law49](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc), [N45.1](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BON-n-2008-90013&p=20260420&tn=1). | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 49 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a49 | 1. Podrán excluirse de gravamen las ganancias patrimoniales obtenidas por la transmisión de la vivienda habitual de la o del contribuyente, siempre que concurra alguna circunstancia que justifique el cambio de vivienda y el importe obtenido en la transmisión se reinvierta en la adquisición de una nueva vivienda habitual en las condiciones que reglamentariamente se | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

| 212 | The base / Replacement-home reinvestment method; LF136 | The ordinary window is **two years after disposal**; the local regulations also admit the stated qualifying new-home acquisition within the **two preceding years**. Keep the actual acquisition/payment dates and destination of proceeds. For an instalment-price disposal, apply the rule requiring each receipt to be devoted to the qualifying purpose within the tax period in which it is received. If reinvestment is deferred beyond the disposal year, state the intention to reinvest in that gain year's return. The Basque regulations assimilate qualifying rehabilitation under local law87.6. Navarra40.3 includes acquisition/rehabilitation payments and buyer-borne acquisition costs;40.8 requires the competent body's certificate for qualifying rehabilitation. Its40.7 construction route requires completion within four years from investment commencement, with a further four years for the stated developer-insolvency case and investment/insolvency documents attached to the initial-breach-year return. For other exceptional construction delays beyond the taxpayer’s control, request an extension within thirty days after the initial deadline is missed, with reasons and the necessary completion period (at most four additional years); silence for three months permits treating the request as refused. The twelve-month occupation clock in the insolvency case starts on delivery; do not treat an unfinished build as an unconditional completed acquisition. [B49](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241), [A46](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice-reglamento_irpf_cas-2-pdf), [G45](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0755457E7/DF%2033-2014%20(2026-2).pdf/7e4c25eb-a139-fa5f-d310-deaa4c4bcffd), [N40](https://www.navarra.es/es/web/normativa-hacienda/-/reglamento-del-impuesto-sobre-la-renta-de-las-personas-f%C3%ADsicas-df-174/1999-de-24-de-mayo-?print=true). | B DF47/2014 article 49 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241#a49 | 2. El incumplimiento de cualquiera de las condiciones establecidas en este artículo determinará el sometimiento a gravamen de la ganancia patrimonial correspondiente. En tal caso, la persona contribuyente imputará la parte de la ganancia patrimonial no exenta al año de su obtención, practicando autoliquidación complementaria, con inclusión de los correspondientes intereses de demora. Esta autoliquidación complementaria se presentará en el plazo que medie entre la fecha en que se produzca el incumplimiento y la finalización del plazo reglamentario de autoliquidación correspondiente al período impositivo en que se produzca dicho incumplimiento. | 2026-10-28 | rule |
| 226 | The base / Disposal proceeds reinvested in an insured life annuity; LF146 | For a person **older than65**, B42(f)/regulation49bis, A42(f)/46bis, G42.1(f)/45bis and N45.3 provide their own asset-disposal-gain exemption where proceeds constitute an **insured life annuity in that taxpayer's favour**. This is a disposal-gain method, separate from the pension/annuity-yield exemptions later in this Guide. Constitute the annuity within **six months of disposal**, contract with an insurer with the taxpayer as beneficiary, notify the insurer that it is a disposal-proceeds reinvestment, start payments within **one year of constitution**, pay at least annually, and ensure annual payments do not decrease by **more than5%** from the preceding year. The provisions permit the stated reversion, certain-payment-period or death-counterinsurance mechanisms. An annual payment falling from10,000 to9,500 meets the5% condition;9,499 does not. A periodic investment product without an insured life-annuity contract does not satisfy these provisions. [B49bis](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241), [A46bis](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice-reglamento_irpf_cas-2-pdf), [G45bis](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0755457E7/DF%2033-2014%20(2026-2).pdf/7e4c25eb-a139-fa5f-d310-deaa4c4bcffd), [N45.3](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BON-n-2008-90013&p=20260420&tn=1). | B DF47/2014 article 49bis | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241#a49bis | 2. | 274 | The base / Ordinary listed and unlisted share disposals; LF173 | Use FIFO for homogeneous securities. Before using a loss, apply B/A/G43(g)/(h) or N39.6(f)/(g): acquisition of homogeneous listed securities within the two months before/after disposal, or unlisted securities in the year before/after, defers the corresponding loss until the retained securities are disposed of under the local rule. Keep the blocked-loss ledger instead of deducting the same loss and carrying it again. | 289 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF181 | Select the actual territory before computing a fungible coin disposal. The following ordinary investment method uses the local property-gain and savings rules already supplied above and below. It does not classify a service, mining or staking receipt as an investment disposal merely because it is paid in coins. Keep euro acquisition and disposal records, fractional units, transaction-specific expenses, execution times and both market values for a swap. Retain opening lots and remaining units across the taxpayer's exchanges and wallets. The local crypto FIFO definition is based on units originating in the **same protocol with the same characteristics**, rather than an exchange's ticker or an account-level accounting election. | 313 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF191 | **Fiat/FIFO calculation:** suppose each Basque taxpayer buys one same-type unit in2026 for EUR2,000 plus EUR20 inherent acquisition expense, then another for EUR3,000 plus EUR30. They sell0.5unit for EUR1,800 when its market reference is EUR1,750 and pay EUR18 inherent seller expense. The factor is1.000; FIFO acquisition value is `2,020 ×0.5 = 1,010`, net transfer value is `max(1,800,1,750) −18 = 1,782`, and gain is **EUR772**. Selecting the later lot would incorrectly give EUR267. If these are the only savings items and no savings-base reduction applies, the supplied2026 first19% band produces **EUR146.68 gross savings quota**, before credits and the rest of annual settlement. If agreed proceeds instead fall below the statutory market reference, use the latter before deducting the qualifying seller expense. This example uses the local44–47 measurement and76 scale, not a common-territory rate table. To distinguish the update, a separate2025 lot costing EUR1,000 plus EUR10 inherent acquisition expense uses the actual2026 table's **2025 factor1.020**: updated cost EUR1,030.20. With2026 transfer reference EUR1,450 and EUR14.50 seller expense, gain is **EUR405.30**, rather than EUR425.50 without the update. The three actual annual coefficient enactments linked above establish both factors. | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 45 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a45 | 1. | 319 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF193 | **Swap calculation:** with outgoing tax acquisition value EUR1,000, outgoing market value EUR4,000 and received-token market value EUR4,500, a fee-free swap gives **EUR3,500 gain**, even though no euro cash is received. Reversing the two market values still gives EUR3,500. For Álava, the own instruction above establishes **EUR4,500 received-asset acquisition value** on the first facts. **Own-law received-basis derivation for B/G/Navarra:** carry the same gross swap valuation `M = max(market value given, market value received)` into the acquired lot before its own acquisition expenses. This is an expressly labelled derivation from each territory's own ordinary acquisition-value and taxable-swap provisions, not an assertion that an own crypto instruction prints that algebra: B44/45/47.1(i), G44/45/47.1(j), and N40/41/43.1(h) measure the outgoing property's realised exchange consideration and the acquired property's onerous cost. The computation treats the value recognised in that taxable exchange as the incoming tax cost, rather than taxing that same recognised exchange value again as a zero-cost receipt. The cited own G/Navarra manuals confirm the greater-of-two swap measure; they are not cited as explicit received-basis rulings. Álava's explicit own instruction is distinguished above. On either ordering of the EUR4,000/EUR4,500 quotations in this example, the derived B/G/Navarra incoming basis is **EUR4,500**, dated at the swap. This method uses each territory's own acquisition/swap structure; neither the State ruling nor Álava's instruction is legal authority for B/G/Navarra. Preserve both market quotes and the legal rights exchanged. | 325 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF195 | **Direct mixed-fee worksheet:** under B/A/G45.1(b)/45.3 and N41.1(b)/41.2, assign only taxpayer-borne inherent acquisition/disposal expense to its actual side of the transaction. Write `Eout` for disposal expense and `Ein` for incoming acquisition expense: `outgoing gain = M − Eout − outgoing tax acquisition value`; `incoming initial acquisition value = M + Ein`. Apply the Basque annual update by the year of each acquisition-cost/expense component when the lot is later sold, using the actual disposal-year table; Navarra's examined41 has no such update. Do not carry the net `M−Eout` into the received lot or count one cost on both sides. For a combined fee, use the invoice/contract service split; if a single price covers both, an evidenced consistent driver such as the provider's separately quoted prices for the same services gives the derived allocation `Eout = E × wout/(wout+win)`, `Ein = E−Eout`. No own provision cited here mandates50:50 or another fixed percentage. Establish the underlying services, bearer and pricing evidence rather than inventing a split; an unsupported breakdown remains an evidence question. A network/funding/withdrawal label alone does not establish inherency. Sources: the respective [B40/44/45/47](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068), [A40/44/45/47](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf), [G40/44/45/47](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc) and [N39–43](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BON-n-2008-90013&p=20260420&tn=1). | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 45 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a45 | 1. | 343 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF181 | Select the actual territory before computing a fungible coin disposal. The following ordinary investment method uses the local property-gain and savings rules already supplied above and below. It does not classify a service, mining or staking receipt as an investment disposal merely because it is paid in coins. Keep euro acquisition and disposal records, fractional units, transaction-specific expenses, execution times and both market values for a swap. Retain opening lots and remaining units across the taxpayer's exchanges and wallets. The local crypto FIFO definition is based on units originating in the **same protocol with the same characteristics**, rather than an exchange's ticker or an account-level accounting election. Authorities: [B NF13/2013 arts.43–47](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068), [A NF33/2013 arts.43–47](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf), [G NF3/2014 arts.43–47](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc), [N DFL4/2008 arts.39–43](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BON-n-2008-90013&p=20260420&tn=1). | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 47 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a47 | p) De la transmisión a título oneroso de criptoactivos fungibles, la ganancia o pérdida se computará por la diferencia entre su valor de adquisición y el valor de transmisión, determinado por el valor de referencia fijado como resultado de la oferta y la demanda | 2026-10-28 | rule |

| 346 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF191 | **Fiat/FIFO calculation:** suppose each Basque taxpayer buys one same-type unit in2026 for EUR2,000 plus EUR20 inherent acquisition expense, then another for EUR3,000 plus EUR30. They sell0.5unit for EUR1,800 when its market reference is EUR1,750 and pay EUR18 inherent seller expense. The factor is1.000; FIFO acquisition value is `2,020 ×0.5 = 1,010`, net transfer value is `max(1,800,1,750) −18 = 1,782`, and gain is **EUR772**. Selecting the later lot would incorrectly give EUR267. If these are the only savings items and no savings-base reduction applies, the supplied2026 first19% band produces **EUR146.68 gross savings quota**, before credits and the rest of annual settlement. If agreed proceeds instead fall below the statutory market reference, use the latter before deducting the qualifying seller expense. This example uses the local44–47 measurement and76 scale, not a common-territory rate table. To distinguish the update, a separate2025 lot costing EUR1,000 plus EUR10 inherent acquisition expense uses the actual2026 table's **2025 factor1.020**: updated cost EUR1,030.20. With2026 transfer reference EUR1,450 and EUR14.50 seller expense, gain is **EUR405.30**, rather than EUR425.50 without the update. The three actual annual coefficient enactments linked above establish both factors. | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 47 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a47 | p) De la transmisión a título oneroso de criptoactivos fungibles, la ganancia o pérdida se computará por la diferencia entre su valor de adquisición y el valor de transmisión, determinado por el valor de referencia fijado como resultado de la oferta y la demanda | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

| 358 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF193 | **Swap calculation:** with outgoing tax acquisition value EUR1,000, outgoing market value EUR4,000 and received-token market value EUR4,500, a fee-free swap gives **EUR3,500 gain**, even though no euro cash is received. Reversing the two market values still gives EUR3,500. For Álava, the own instruction above establishes **EUR4,500 received-asset acquisition value** on the first facts. **Own-law received-basis derivation for B/G/Navarra:** carry the same gross swap valuation `M = max(market value given, market value received)` into the acquired lot before its own acquisition expenses. This is an expressly labelled derivation from each territory's own ordinary acquisition-value and taxable-swap provisions, not an assertion that an own crypto instruction prints that algebra: B44/45/47.1(i), G44/45/47.1(j), and N40/41/43.1(h) measure the outgoing property's realised exchange consideration and the acquired property's onerous cost. The computation treats the value recognised in that taxable exchange as the incoming tax cost, rather than taxing that same recognised exchange value again as a zero-cost receipt. The cited own G/Navarra manuals confirm the greater-of-two swap measure; they are not cited as explicit received-basis rulings. Álava's explicit own instruction is distinguished above. On either ordering of the EUR4,000/EUR4,500 quotations in this example, the derived B/G/Navarra incoming basis is **EUR4,500**, dated at the swap. This method uses each territory's own acquisition/swap structure; neither the State ruling nor Álava's instruction is legal authority for B/G/Navarra. Preserve both market quotes and the legal rights exchanged. | 361 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF195 | **Direct mixed-fee worksheet:** under B/A/G45.1(b)/45.3 and N41.1(b)/41.2, assign only taxpayer-borne inherent acquisition/disposal expense to its actual side of the transaction. Write `Eout` for disposal expense and `Ein` for incoming acquisition expense: `outgoing gain = M − Eout − outgoing tax acquisition value`; `incoming initial acquisition value = M + Ein`. Apply the Basque annual update by the year of each acquisition-cost/expense component when the lot is later sold, using the actual disposal-year table; Navarra's examined41 has no such update. Do not carry the net `M−Eout` into the received lot or count one cost on both sides. For a combined fee, use the invoice/contract service split; if a single price covers both, an evidenced consistent driver such as the provider's separately quoted prices for the same services gives the derived allocation `Eout = E × wout/(wout+win)`, `Ein = E−Eout`. No own provision cited here mandates50:50 or another fixed percentage. Establish the underlying services, bearer and pricing evidence rather than inventing a split; an unsupported breakdown remains an evidence question. A network/funding/withdrawal label alone does not establish inherency. | 362 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF195 | **Direct mixed-fee worksheet:** under B/A/G45.1(b)/45.3 and N41.1(b)/41.2, assign only taxpayer-borne inherent acquisition/disposal expense to its actual side of the transaction. Write `Eout` for disposal expense and `Ein` for incoming acquisition expense: `outgoing gain = M − Eout − outgoing tax acquisition value`; `incoming initial acquisition value = M + Ein`. Apply the Basque annual update by the year of each acquisition-cost/expense component when the lot is later sold, using the actual disposal-year table; Navarra's examined41 has no such update. Do not carry the net `M−Eout` into the received lot or count one cost on both sides. For a combined fee, use the invoice/contract service split; if a single price covers both, an evidenced consistent driver such as the provider's separately quoted prices for the same services gives the derived allocation `Eout = E × wout/(wout+win)`, `Ein = E−Eout`. No own provision cited here mandates50:50 or another fixed percentage. Establish the underlying services, bearer and pricing evidence rather than inventing a split; an unsupported breakdown remains an evidence question. A network/funding/withdrawal label alone does not establish inherency. | 367 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF201 | **Loss recognition precedes annual netting.** In B/A/G, local43(i) blocks the corresponding loss on same-type fungible crypto when acquisitions occur in the **two months before or after** disposal. Keep the computed loss, affected units, acquisition/disposal dates and later matching disposals in a blocked-loss ledger. B's final release paragraph expressly names(g)/(h)/(i), although its remaining noun is securities/participations; own [B Instruction1/2026 section8.10](https://www.bizkaia.eus/instrucciones/instruccion_1_2026_75_es.pdf) expressly includes fungible crypto and release as the matching number of retained units is disposed of. G's actual amendment expressly names(g)/(h)/(i) and retained **assets**, supplying its release route. For a B/G loss of EUR1,000 blocked against one matched retained unit, a later qualifying disposal of0.4unit releases **EUR400** and leaves EUR600 on these simple matching facts; test the later acquisition windows rather than presuming every later sale releases an unconditional loss. The ordinary four-year loss carry is for a recognised negative savings balance, not an automatic deduction of a loss still blocked by43(i). Authorities: current [B43](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068), [G43 and actual2025 amendment](https://egoitza.gipuzkoa.eus/gao-bog/castell/bog/2025/11/28/c2508038.pdf). | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 43 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a43 | i) Las derivadas de las transmisiones de criptoactivos fungibles, cuando el o la contribuyente hubiera adquirido activos del mismo tipo dentro de los dos meses anteriores o posteriores a dichas transmisiones. | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

| 373 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF213 | **Annual savings routing:** put measured and admissible nonbusiness disposal results into the local savings-disposal basket, then use the existing full territorial scales and annual settlement. B/A/G63(c)/66 do not permit a disposal loss to cross-offset financial returns; the ordinary negative disposal balance carries against the same basket for four following years. N54 permits its25% cross-offset with the other positive savings basket and the four-year carry in statutory order. For a recognised disposal loss EUR2,000 and positive savings returns EUR4,000, with no other balances, B/A/G retain the EUR2,000 loss in the disposal carry. Navarra permits EUR1,000 cross-offset, leaving **EUR3,000 positive returns and EUR1,000 loss carry**. The Basque securities-only3% small-listed-disposal election above is not a crypto election. Sources: [B63/66/76](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068), [A63/66/76](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf), [G63/66/76](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc), [N54/60](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BON-n-2008-90013&p=20260420&tn=1). | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 66 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a66 | Si el resultado de la integración y compensación a que se refiere esta letra a) arrojase saldo negativo, su importe sólo se podrá compensar con el saldo positivo de los rendimientos a que se refiere esta letra a) que se pongan de manifiesto durante los cuatro años siguientes. | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

| 433 | The base / Basque business-asset gain: article 75.3 quota adjustment; LF245 | Calculate the ordinary general-scale quota `Q` on the general liquidable base `B` before the article 77 minoración. For positive `B`, express `100 × Q / B` as a percentage with two decimals. If that general average rate does not exceed the **general corporate rate of 24%**, there is no article 75.3 reduction. If it exceeds 24%, reduce gross quota by `(general_average_percent − 24) / 100 × qualifying_business_asset_gain`. The gain must form part of **positive net economic-activity income**. Deduct business-asset losses already taken into account in that activity's net income from the business-asset gains for this measure. This does not reclassify the disposal into the savings basket, and the taxpayer's marginal IRPF rate is not the average rate. | 439 | The base / Basque business-asset gain: article 75.3 quota adjustment; LF247 | Álava and Gipuzkoa additionally reduce this gain measure by **prior-year negative business balances actually compensated**, as their article 75.3 expressly requires. Bizkaia's article 75.3 has the current business-asset loss adjustment but does not contain that additional prior-business-balance paragraph. Apply the actual territory's provision and use no negative gain measure to generate a quota increase. Then apply the article 77 minoración and the remaining annual settlement below. At general base 40,000, the supplied scale gives `Q = 9,220.80 + (40,000 − 36,160) × 35% = 10,564.80`; the general average is 26.41%. With 10,000 eligible net business-asset gain in positive business income, the reduction is 241.00. In Álava/Gipuzkoa, if 6,000 prior business negative balances are actually compensated and the same stated 40,000 liquidable base remains after all adjustments, the gain measure is 4,000 and the reduction is 96.40. With no qualifying positive business-asset gain, the reduction is zero. [Bizkaia](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068), [Álava](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf), [Gipuzkoa](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc) art. 75.3. | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 75 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a75 | A efectos de la aplicación de lo dispuesto en el párrafo anterior, del importe de las ganancias patrimoniales se deducirá, en su caso, el de las pérdidas patrimoniales que se hubiesen tenido en cuenta para la determinación del rendimiento neto de la actividad. | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

| 444 | The base / Basque business-asset gain: article 75.3 quota adjustment; LF249 | Subtract the EUR 1,615 art 77 minoración **from general-scale quota**, with a zero floor, then add savings-scale quota. Álava residents in qualifying rural nuclei/zones with population≤500 subtract an additional EUR 200 from general quota under art 77.2. The unused minoración does not reduce savings quota. Then apply qualifying personal/family/housing/other quota credits, with the art 78 zero floor, preserving eligible carryforwards. Finally subtract documented withholding, payments on account and instalments under Bizkaia/Álava art 95 or Gipuzkoa art 94. A negative differential produces the refund route; zero flooring liquid quota does not erase documented payments. [Bizkaia NF13/2013, current2026 consolidation](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068)[Álava NF33/2013, current2026 consolidation](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf)[Gipuzkoa NF3/2014,2026 consolidation](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc) arts 74–78,95/94. | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 77 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a77 | Los y las contribuyentes aplicarán una minoración de cuota de 1.615 euros por cada declaración, conforme a lo previsto en el artículo 74 de esta Norma Foral. | 2026-10-28 | rule |

Support under a qualifying judicial arrangement can substitute for cohabitation under the precise territorial art 79.5. Apply legal guardianship/fostering/representative-curatorship assimilations. These are quota deductions, not taxable-base allowances. En el supuesto de que se opte por la tributación conjunta y existan varias personas con derecho a aplicar esta deducción, que cumplan los requisitos para la aplicación de porcentajes incrementados de deducción de acuerdo con lo previsto en este apartado y otras que no los cumplan, se aplicarán los porcentajes y el límite previstos en este apartado. 221 Este apartado ha sido modificado por el apartado siete del ordinal primero del artículo 4 de la Norma Foral 2/2025, de 24 de noviembre, por la que se adapta la normativa tributaria del Territorio Histórico de Gipuzkoa a las modificaciones del Concierto Económico con la Comunidad Autónoma del País Vasco aprobadas por la Ley 3/2025, de 29 de abril, y se aprueban otras modificaciones tributarias. La norma foral entra en vigor el día siguiente al de publicación en el Boletín Oficial de Gipuzkoa (BOG 28/11/2025) y la modificación surte efectos a partir de 1 de enero de […] | 2026-10-28 | rule |

| 802 | The base / Mixed salary and business income: Bizkaia and Álava credit pool; LF387 | For the ordinary **positive general-BI case** in **Bizkaia and Álava**, the published territorial instructions give the allocation explicitly: `business_quota_pool = general_gross_quota ×business_income_in_general_BI /total_general_BI`. The denominator is **base imponible general**, not base liquidable after pension/joint reductions, and not general-plus-savings income. The numerator is the actual admitted business-income component in that general BI, aggregated over the person's relevant businesses, not gross turnover. Use the general quota after the applicable article77 minoración and statutory general-quota adjustments; savings quota and the separate listed-share3% levy are outside this pool. Establish the annual tax calculation first rather than taxing the business profit alone through a new copy of the progressive bands. | Bizkaia NF13/2013 article 88 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068#a88 | 2. | 838 | The base / Gipuzkoa ordinary positive-income business-credit pool: stated inference; LF401 | For a hypothetical2026 individual, admitted net salary24,000 and business income16,000 give general BI40,000. A proved eligible5,000 pension/base reduction gives general BL35,000. Assume no signed offsets, prior business losses, business-asset gains, exempt-progression income, earlier priority credits or five-period-block election. CurrentG75gives `18,080 ×23% +16,920 ×28% =8,896`; G77minoración1,615 leaves7,281. The derived pool is `7,281 ×16,000/40,000 =2,912.40`. With an independently entitled ordinary annual35%-group credit2,000, the cap is1,019.34; use1,019.34 and retain980.66 under88.3's actual carry rules. | 868 | The base / Housing, care, pension and ordinary spending credits; LF299 | **Professional-caregiver qualification, Bizkaia.** The EUR 500 enhancement is limited to the disabled/dependent population in article 83 bis.2(b)/(c); an otherwise eligible under-12-only care claim stays at EUR 250 even if the carer holds a professional credential. Under DF 47/2014 article 66 bis, obtain the actual credential and establish its applicable category: Técnico/a en Cuidados Auxiliares de Enfermería (RD 546/1995), including the listed clinical/psychiatric/nursing-assistant equivalents (RD 777/1998); Técnico/a en Atención a Personas en Situación de Dependencia (RD 1593/2011), including the Atención Sociosanitaria equivalent (RD 496/2003); Técnico/a Superior en Integración Social (RD 1074/2012 or the RD 2061/1995 equivalent), subject to article 66 bis.1(c)'s stated assistance-personal/home-help-functions condition; higher qualifications in Health, Education or Social Sciences; institutional sociocare professional certification under RD 1379/2008; home sociocare certification under that decree or the RD 331/1997 home-help equivalent; or a subsequently published certificate with the same professional effects. Paragraph 2 permits the stated certification from the competent Basque employment/social-policy department or another autonomous community where the required title is absent. A job description, private course or work history alone is not proof of that authority certification or professional equivalence. [Current DF 47/2014 article 66 bis](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241), [actual DF 133/2025 article 1.Primero.10](https://www.bizkaia.eus/lehendakaritza/Bao_bob/2025/12/30/I-1406_cas.pdf). | B DF47/2014 article 66bis | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241#a66bis | a) Título de Técnico o Técnica en Cuidados Auxiliares de Enfermería regulado por el Real Decreto 546/1995, de 7 de abril, o los títulos equivalentes de Técnico o Técnica Auxiliar Clínica, Técnico o Técnica Auxiliar Psiquiatría y Técnico o Técnica Auxiliar de Enfermería que se establecen en el Real Decreto 777/1998, de 30 de abril, o en su caso, cualquier otro título análogo con los mismos efectos profesionales. | 2026-10-28 | rule |

| 874 | The base / Housing, care, pension and ordinary spending credits; LF301 | **Professional-caregiver qualification, Gipuzkoa; separate Álava route.** DF 33/2014 article 63 bis incorporates DF 6/2023 article 11.3(f) and its first transitional provision, or replacement law. Its express list covers the nursing-assistant and dependency-care technician titles/equivalents, institutional/home sociocare certificates and the legacy home-help certificate described above, plus subsequently published qualifications with the same professional effects. It does not expressly include Bizkaia's broader social-integration/higher-degree categories: establish a separate published-equivalence or valid authority-certificate route before treating a different credential as sufficient. The incorporated first transitional provision requires an actual competent Basque/other autonomous-community **exceptional habilitation certificate**: as at 11 August 2022, the person must meet the three-year/2,000-hour experience route in the professional category of personal assistant in the preceding 12 years or the alternative worked-plus-300-hours relevant-training route for that period and the competencies being accredited. Its provisional exemption expressly ended on 31 December 2023; a former provisional certificate alone does not establish 2026 entitlement. This incorporation concerns professional qualification, not every unrelated condition for the separate social-care benefit. Equal sharing remains: two otherwise eligible B/G taxpayers share EUR 500 as EUR 250 each. Álava article 81 ter instead gives the statutory EUR 250, shared equally, with no professional EUR 500 uplift; do not import either B/G list as an Álava household-credit enhancement. Its distinct article 81 bis personal-assistant credit and same-person incompatibility remain separate. | 876 | The base / Housing, care, pension and ordinary spending credits; LF303 | **Return-to-work deemed-return evidence, Bizkaia/Gipuzkoa.** The statutes' **jobseeker route**, as distinct from an actual employment/self-employment return, requires both the registration certificate from Lanbide or another public employment service **and** formalisation of the activity agreement under Ley 3/2023. | 877 | The base / Housing, care, pension and ordinary spending credits; LF305 | **Offer refusal and recapture, Bizkaia/Gipuzkoa.** For this deemed-return route, refusing an offer made by the employment service or a collaborating entity breaches the return condition unless an actual Ley 14/2022 article 48.2 circumstance applies. Preserve the offer, refusal/reason and exception evidence. Article 48.2 incorporates the precise article 45.3(a)/(b)/(c)/(f) occupational/aptitude, public-transport schedule, prescribed-radius and family-care circumstances. It separately covers minimum commuting time **exceeding 25%** of daily working time, public-transport cost **exceeding 20%** of offered monthly salary, or pay not equivalent to the applicable company/sector agreement. Exactly 25% or 20% does not meet those respective “exceeds” tests. Do not substitute other general RGI defences for these exact tax cross-references. On breach, repay the improperly deducted amount with actual late-payment interest by adding it to the **differential quota for the tax period in which the breach occurs**. The B66 ter/G63 ter implementation rules apply from 1 January 2025 despite their December 2025 publication; the original enacted Bizkaia text already requires both documents. Gipuzkoa's February 2026 correction changes housing transitional numbering, not these care provisions. | 881 | The base / Housing, care, pension and ordinary spending credits; LF305 | **Offer refusal and recapture, Bizkaia/Gipuzkoa.** For this deemed-return route, refusing an offer made by the employment service or a collaborating entity breaches the return condition unless an actual Ley 14/2022 article 48.2 circumstance applies. Preserve the offer, refusal/reason and exception evidence. Article 48.2 incorporates the precise article 45.3(a)/(b)/(c)/(f) occupational/aptitude, public-transport schedule, prescribed-radius and family-care circumstances. It separately covers minimum commuting time **exceeding 25%** of daily working time, public-transport cost **exceeding 20%** of offered monthly salary, or pay not equivalent to the applicable company/sector agreement. Exactly 25% or 20% does not meet those respective “exceeds” tests. Do not substitute other general RGI defences for these exact tax cross-references. On breach, repay the improperly deducted amount with actual late-payment interest by adding it to the **differential quota for the tax period in which the breach occurs**. The B66 ter/G63 ter implementation rules apply from 1 January 2025 despite their December 2025 publication; the original enacted Bizkaia text already requires both documents. Gipuzkoa's February 2026 correction changes housing transitional numbering, not these care provisions. | 906 | The base / Housing, care, pension and ordinary spending credits; LF317 | Under Bizkaia 93 bis, Álava 94 bis and Gipuzkoa 92 bis, unused main-home-rent credits carry five years. Use originating-year conditions/limits and the first year with sufficient quota, before the same current-year credit. Apply any additional named carry rules separately. | 918 | The base / Ordinary Basque employee share purchases; LF351 | Apply the own incorporated issuer tests. B/A corporate13 uses the economic-operation test (at least85% qualifying business/professional income), micro/small/medium size and staff limits, shareholder and group aggregation rules;13.5 limits a corporate shareholder's disqualification tests to quantitative13(b)/(c). Use the [foral corporate company-size method](es-foral-corporate-tax.md#the-base), including the correct prior/current-period reference and annualisation. **Bizkaia published entry exception:** own2026 Instruction15.10.1.2 expressly deems the SME condition satisfied where the issuer was disqualified because a large company held more than25%, but becomes micro/small/medium precisely because its employees acquire the shares. Do not deny that entry solely by applying the generic prior-period test above. For an otherwise eligible20-worker trading small company, assume the large shareholder held30% in2025 and sells that entire stake in an equal2026 offer to all20 unrelated employees: each pays10,000 for1.5%, removing that disqualifying holding and creating qualifying SME status, with all remaining issuer/89 gates met. A male employee's credit is **10,000×10%=1,000** with adequate quota; the prior-year large ownership alone does not make it zero. If the acquisition does not actually create SME status, this exception does not cure that failure or any unequal-offer, family-ownership or holding-period failure. [Own B Instruction1/2026](https://www.bizkaia.eus/instrucciones/instruccion_1_2026_75_es.pdf)15.10.1.2. For A/G employee shares, calculate the asset condition over at least90days: **more than half** the adjusted assets in values/nonbusiness assets under the territory's own14.1(a)/14.2 fails this gate even if the shareholder or income limbs of the complete patrimonial-company definition fail. Apply the actual own14.2 exclusions/adjustments to accounting assets; do not substitute an unadjusted balance or a complete-patrimonial-status yes/no answer. Asimismo, será deducible, exclusivamente: a) El importe de los intereses de los capitales ajenos invertidos en la adquisición, rehabilitación o mejora de los bienes, derechos o facultades de uso o disfrute de los que procedan los rendimientos, y demás gastos de financiación. A estos efectos, de las cantidades satisfechas se restará el importe de las subvenciones que el o la contribuyente hubiera, en su caso, recibido para hacer frente al pago de los conceptos mencionados, siempre que resulten exentas en aplicación de la normativa reguladora de este impuesto. b) El importe de las primas de seguros de crédito que cubran total o parcialmente el impago de las rentas a las que el o la contribuyente tenga derecho por razón del arrendamiento, con el límite de 300 euros. A estos efectos, de las cantidades satisfechas se restará el importe de las subvenciones que la persona contribuyente hubiera, en su caso, recibido para hacer frente al pago de los conceptos mencionados, siempre que resulten exentas en aplicación de la normativa reguladora de este impuesto. b) El importe de las primas de seguros de crédito que cubran total o parcialmente el impago de las rentas a las que la persona contribuyente tenga derecho por razón del arrendamiento, con el límite de 300 euros. La suma de la bonificación y de los gastos deducibles no podrá dar lugar, para cada inmueble, a un rendimiento neto negativo. | 2026-10-28 | rule / computed illustration where expressly labelled: Exact retained primary quotation; selected native source scope is preserved in source-read-scopes. | 972 | The base / Landlord income, expenses, depreciation and tax basket; LF522 | For a nonhousing investment property, deduct necessary financing, qualifying nonsanctionary property taxes/charges, administration/security/concierge costs, lease formalisation and legal defence, repairs/replacement that maintain normal use, property insurance and utilities. [B](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068) art 32.6 and [BR](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf) arts 37–38; [A](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf) art 32.4 and [AR](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice-reglamento_irpf_cas-2-pdf) arts 36–37; [G](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc) art 32.5 and [GR](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0755457E7/DF%2033-2014%20(2026-2).pdf/7e4c25eb-a139-fa5f-d310-deaa4c4bcffd) arts 35–36. | Bizkaia DF47/2014 37; BR_costs | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf | En los supuestos contemplados en el apartado 6 del artículo 32 de la Norma Foral del Impuesto, tendrán la consideración de gasto deducible para la determinación del rendimiento neto, todos los gastos necesarios para su obtención y el importe del deterioro sufrido por el uso o transcurso del tiempo en los bienes o derechos de los que procedan los rendimientos. No obstante, la suma de los gastos deducibles no podrá dar lugar, para cada inmueble, a rendimiento neto negativo. En particular, se considerarán incluidos entre los gastos a que se refiere el párrafo anterior: a) Los intereses de los capitales ajenos invertidos en la adquisición, rehabilitación o mejora de los bienes, derechos o facultades de uso o disfrute de los que procedan los rendimientos, y demás gastos de financiación. b) Los tributos y recargos no estatales, así como las tasas y recargos estatales, cualquiera que sea su denominación, siempre que incidan sobre los rendimientos computados o sobre los bienes o derechos productores de los mismos y no tengan carácter sancionador o deriven del retraso en el cumplimiento de las obligaciones tributarias. c) Las cantidades devengadas por terceros en contraprestación directa o indirecta o como consecuencia de servicios personales, tales como los de administración, vigilancia, portería o similares. 30 d) Los ocasionados por la formalización del arrendamiento, subarrendamiento, cesión o constitución de derechos y los de defensa de carácter jurídico relativos a los bienes, derechos o rendimientos. e) Los gastos de conservación y reparación. A estos efectos tendrán esta consideración: - Los efectuados regularmente con la finalidad de mantener el uso normal de los bienes materiales, como el pintado, revoco o arreglo de instalaciones. - Los de sustitución de elementos, como instalaciones de calefacción, ascensor, puertas de seguridad u otros. No serán deducibles por este concepto las cantidades destinadas a ampliación o mejora de los bienes. f) El importe de las primas de contratos de seguro, bien sean de responsabilidad civil, incendio, robo, rotura de cristales u otros de naturaleza análoga, sobre los bienes o derechos productores de los rendimientos. g) Las cantidades destinadas a servicios o suministros. h) Las cantidades destinadas a la amortización en las condiciones establecidas en el artículo siguiente. | 2026-10-28 | rule / computed illustration where expressly labelled: Exact retained primary quotation; selected native source scope is preserved in source-read-scopes. En particular, se considerarán incluidos entre los gastos a que se refiere el párrafo anterior: a) Los intereses de los capitales ajenos invertidos en la adquisición, rehabilitación o mejora de los bienes, derechos o facultades de uso o disfrute de los que procedan los rendimientos, y demás gastos de financiación. b) Los tributos y recargos no estatales, así como las tasas y recargos estatales, cualquiera que sea su denominación, siempre que incidan sobre los rendimientos computados o sobre los bienes o derechos productores de los mismos y no tengan carácter sancionador o deriven del retraso en el cumplimiento de las obligaciones tributarias. c) Las cantidades devengadas por terceros en contraprestación directa o indirecta o como consecuencia de servicios personales, tales como los de administración, vigilancia, portería o similares. 33 d) Los ocasionados por la formalización del arrendamiento, subarrendamiento, cesión o constitución de derechos y los de defensa de carácter jurídico relativos a los bienes, derechos o rendimientos. e) Los gastos de conservación y reparación. A estos efectos tendrán esta consideración: - Los efectuados regularmente con la finalidad de mantener el uso normal de los bienes materiales, como el pintado, revoco o arreglo de instalaciones. - Los de sustitución de elementos, como instalaciones de calefacción, ascensor, puertas de seguridad u otros. | 1058 | Deadlines and filing; LF695 | Bizkaia/Álava art 102 and Gipuzkoa art 101 exempt only the specified exclusive income mix: gross work≤20,000 per person, and aggregate gross capital income/gains including exempt≤1,600, subject to the specified investment-fund withholding-base exception. | 1064 | Deadlines and filing / Ordinary foral personal-business instalments; LF721 | **Bizkaia, [DF 47/2014 arts. 109–112](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf).** Professionals are exempt for the relevant activity if at least 70% of its penultimate-year receipts were subject to withholding/payments on account. Agriculture/livestock/forestry has a separate 70% test excluding current/capital grants and indemnities. In the start year and following year use that payment period's receipt share instead. Ordinary established activities pay **5% of penultimate-year net activity income each quarter**, less 25% of the corresponding penultimate-year activity withholding/payments on account. If the penultimate year was the start year, annualise that year's net income. If penultimate net income was nonpositive, the general fallback is **0.5% of that year's sales/receipts less 25% of that year's activity withholding/payments on account**; wholesalers use **0.25% of that year's sales/receipts**. The current [specific authority explanation](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/faq/faq_detalle.asp?idregistro=900001002&IdEtiquetaBuscar=190&Idioma=CA&Tem_Codigo=7884&pant=listado) and [official form instructions](https://www.bizkaia.eus/fitxategiak/05/ogasuna/ereduak/Argitaratu/130CasInst.pdf) confirm these branches: the visually checked [form](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/ereduak/descargar_documento.asp?Idioma=CA&val1=8AA405AF81D76CC992B77CD9B7C7112FCA1B1651B529D2961D5EFE269326793A) has general fallback boxes 15–18 with the 25% withholding deduction in box 17, while its wholesale branch uses boxes 19–20 without an additional deduction box. Do not invent the general branch's offset in the wholesale branch. In the start year and next year the general route is **20% of the current calendar quarter's accrued income less deductible expenses**, less that quarter's activity withholding/payments on account. It is not the State cumulative year-to-date method. Agriculture/livestock/forestry/fishing instead uses **2% of current-quarter sales/receipts**, excluding capital grants and indemnities, **less that quarter's withholding/payments on account**. The [current authority explanation](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/faq/faq_detalle.asp?idregistro=900001003&IdEtiquetaBuscar=190&Idioma=CA&Tem_Codigo=7884&pant=listado) and actual form boxes 05–08 implement this deduction; its box 07 is current-quarter withholding. An established ordinary business with 2024 net income 40,000 and withholding 800 pays `2,000 − 200 = 1,800` for an otherwise payable quarter; a start-year quarter with income 15,000, expenses 10,000 and withholding 100 gives `1,000 − 100 = 900`. With penultimate net income zero, receipts 100,000 and corresponding activity withholding 80, the ordinary fallback is `500 − 20 = 480`; the wholesale branch gives 250. Qualifying primary-sector quarterly receipts 10,000 with withholding 50 give `200 − 50 = 150`. | B DF47/2014 article 109 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241#a109 | 2. No obstante lo dispuesto en el apartado anterior, los contribuyentes que desarrollen actividades agrícolas, ganaderas o forestales no estarán obligados a efectuar pago fraccionado en relación con las mismas si, en el penúltimo año anterior al que correspondan los pagos fraccionados, al menos el 70 por 100 de los ingresos procedentes de la explotación, con excepción de las subvenciones corrientes o de capital y las indemnizaciones, fueron objeto de retención o ingreso a cuenta. | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

The current [specific authority explanation](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/faq/faq_detalle.asp?idregistro=900001002&IdEtiquetaBuscar=190&Idioma=CA&Tem_Codigo=7884&pant=listado) and [official form instructions](https://www.bizkaia.eus/fitxategiak/05/ogasuna/ereduak/Argitaratu/130CasInst.pdf) confirm these branches: the visually checked [form](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/ereduak/descargar_documento.asp?Idioma=CA&val1=8AA405AF81D76CC992B77CD9B7C7112FCA1B1651B529D2961D5EFE269326793A) has general fallback boxes 15–18 with the 25% withholding deduction in box 17, while its wholesale branch uses boxes 19–20 without an additional deduction box. Do not invent the general branch's offset in the wholesale branch. In the start year and next year the general route is **20% of the current calendar quarter's accrued income less deductible expenses**, less that quarter's activity withholding/payments on account. It is not the State cumulative year-to-date method. Agriculture/livestock/forestry/fishing instead uses **2% of current-quarter sales/receipts**, excluding capital grants and indemnities, **less that quarter's withholding/payments on account**. The [current authority explanation](https://www.bizkaia.eus/ogasuna/faq/faq_detalle.asp?idregistro=900001003&IdEtiquetaBuscar=190&Idioma=CA&Tem_Codigo=7884&pant=listado) and actual form boxes 05–08 implement this deduction; its box 07 is current-quarter withholding. An established ordinary business with 2024 net income 40,000 and withholding 800 pays `2,000 − 200 = 1,800` for an otherwise payable quarter; a start-year quarter with income 15,000, expenses 10,000 and withholding 100 gives `1,000 − 100 = 900`. With penultimate net income zero, receipts 100,000 and corresponding activity withholding 80, the ordinary fallback is `500 − 20 = 480`; the wholesale branch gives 250. Qualifying primary-sector quarterly receipts 10,000 with withholding 50 give `200 − 50 = 150`. | B DF47/2014 article 110 | https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_47_2014.pdf/c17e2f7e-e4dd-789c-235e-21add02afe5e?t=1710491329241#a110 | b) En particular, cuando se trate de actividades agrícolas, ganaderas, forestales o pesqueras, cualquiera que fuese el método de determinación del rendimiento neto, el 2 por 100 del volumen de ventas o ingresos del trimestre, excluidas las subvenciones de capital y las indemnizaciones. | 2026-10-28 | computed case / labelled own-law derivation: Hypothetical inputs and calculated amounts are computed, not statutory quotations; retain the exact territorial/interpretation boundaries in this Guide unit. |

| 1176 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF193 | **Swap calculation:** with outgoing tax acquisition value EUR1,000, outgoing market value EUR4,000 and received-token market value EUR4,500, a fee-free swap gives **EUR3,500 gain**, even though no euro cash is received. Reversing the two market values still gives EUR3,500. For Álava, the own instruction above establishes **EUR4,500 received-asset acquisition value** on the first facts. **Own-law received-basis derivation for B/G/Navarra:** carry the same gross swap valuation `M = max(market value given, market value received)` into the acquired lot before its own acquisition expenses. This is an expressly labelled derivation from each territory's own ordinary acquisition-value and taxable-swap provisions, not an assertion that an own crypto instruction prints that algebra: B44/45/47.1(i), G44/45/47.1(j), and N40/41/43.1(h) measure the outgoing property's realised exchange consideration and the acquired property's onerous cost. The computation treats the value recognised in that taxable exchange as the incoming tax cost, rather than taxing that same recognised exchange value again as a zero-cost receipt. The cited own G/Navarra manuals confirm the greater-of-two swap measure; they are not cited as explicit received-basis rulings. Álava's explicit own instruction is distinguished above. On either ordering of the EUR4,000/EUR4,500 quotations in this example, the derived B/G/Navarra incoming basis is **EUR4,500**, dated at the swap. This method uses each territory's own acquisition/swap structure; neither the State ruling nor Álava's instruction is legal authority for B/G/Navarra. Preserve both market quotes and the legal rights exchanged. | 1187 | The base / Replacement-home reinvestment method; LF140 | **Gipuzkoa's new regulation45.3** requires a qualifying circumstance arising **after acquisition of the sold home**. It gives concrete family-size, recognised disability/dependency or medical-inadequacy cases; first/new work in a different municipality, changed work centre/job conditions; and marriage/partnership or separation/dissolution. Its economic-payment cases include job loss, work-preventing incapacity, insolvency, acquisition-mortgage commitments **greater than30%** of available income (sum of taxable bases less liquid quotas), or the home's share of planned community rehabilitation/improvements **greater than5%** of its cadastral value. Its business cases include cessation through economic unviability or net income in **two consecutive tax periods** reduced **more than20%** against the average of the **three preceding years**; the activity must represent **more than50%** of total net business and employment income. Exactly30%,5%,20% or50% does not meet its respective strict numerical limb, although another proved statutory cause can still apply. For example, commitments12,000 with available income40,000 are exactly30%;12,000.01 exceed30%. Do not import these Gipuzkoa regulatory numerical limbs into B/A by analogy. The enacted DF27/2025 art1(Segundo1)/DF2 applies the new45 to homes acquired from1January2026; the consolidation's embedded former45 text is historical. G45.2 separately admits the specified judicial-separation former family home while it is the family home or within two years after that status ceases, with spouse/partner and applicable descendants' residence evidence. [G actual amendment and commencement](https://egoitza.gipuzkoa.eus/gao-bog/castell/bog/2025/12/30/c2508991.pdf), [G current45](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0755457E7/DF%2033-2014%20(2026-2).pdf/7e4c25eb-a139-fa5f-d310-deaa4c4bcffd). | G DF33/2014 article 45 | https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0755457E7/DF%2033-2014%20(2026-2).pdf/7e4c25eb-a139-fa5f-d310-deaa4c4bcffd#a45 | c’) Los compromisos de pago derivados del préstamo hipotecario que financió la adquisición de la vivienda comprometan más del 30 por 100 de la renta disponible de la persona o personas contribuyentes titulares de la vivienda. A estos efectos, se considerará renta disponible de dichas personas el sumatorio de sus bases imponibles minorado, en su caso, en el importe del sumatorio de las cuotas líquidas de este impuesto soportadas por las mismas. | 2026-10-28 | computed illustration, sourced underlying rule:  The case inputs/results are derived, not a quotation of statutory amounts. |

Exactly30%,5%,20% or50% does not meet its respective strict numerical limb, although another proved statutory cause can still apply. For example, commitments12,000 with available income40,000 are exactly30%;12,000.01 exceed30%. Do not import these Gipuzkoa regulatory numerical limbs into B/A by analogy. The enacted DF27/2025 art1(Segundo1)/DF2 applies the new45 to homes acquired from1January2026; the consolidation's embedded former45 text is historical. Separately test the mandatory cessation clause for persons losing the stated ownership/power condition during the year, with the required values at cessation; do not use an unchanged or low year-end balance as an automatic exemption from that clause. Test the local exempt-entity and individually identified mercantile-book exceptions, including the precise requirements for an individual economic activity; a personal spreadsheet is not that books exception. | 1398 | The base / Basque 2026 ordinary capital benefits and pre-2026 transition; LF665 | Where the first scheme contribution predates 1 January 2026 and the statutory provider-information condition applies, B DA 42/A DA 40/G DA 42 supply the yield measure instead of an invented current market-return calculation: **1% of the total benefit for each year of membership up to the original contingency, capped at 35%**; if the required membership information is also unavailable, use **25% of the total benefit**. | 1416 | The base / Ordinary nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps and loss timing; LF181 | Select the actual territory before computing a fungible coin disposal. The following ordinary investment method uses the local property-gain and savings rules already supplied above and below. It does not classify a service, mining or staking receipt as an investment disposal merely because it is paid in coins.
